name: Legacy
description: A cache of powerful artifacts which, assembled into a doomsday weapon, can destroy the dark powers that invade Dominaria.

description_citations.text: "Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay undertakes a quest for the Legacy and continues it when Gerrard abandons it.
timeline.quote: She continued this quest even when Gerrard, heir to the Legacy, chose to abandon it.

citation.text: Sisay (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and sold it off piece by piece.
timeline.quote: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece.

citation.text: Volrath (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay sets out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it can kill the Lord of the Wastes, Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Sisay set out to gather the Legacy.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew searches the planes for the pieces of the Legacy before the invasion commences.
timeline.quote: its intrepid crew searches the planes to find all of the pieces of the Legacy before the invasion commences

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke, a servant of the Phyrexians, betrays Sisay and captures her and the Legacy.
timeline.quote: Sisay happily gathered them, only to be betrayed.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leads Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath.
timeline.quote: where they freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn vows never again to let the Legacy slip away.
timeline.quote: Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again.

citation.text: Sift (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn and Hanna stand over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents.
timeline.quote: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts

citation.text: Treasure Trove (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vuel steals the Legacy and deactivates Karn with the Touchstone.
timeline.quote: deactivating him with the Touchstone while he was distracted

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn returns with the Legacy pieces and the Skyshaper.
timeline.quote: Karn returns with the missing pieces of the Legacy as well as the Skyshaper

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza creates the Legacy, then the Bloodline Project, manipulating marriages among families strongest in white mana.
timeline.quote: which led to the creation of the Bloodline Project .

citation.text: "Metathran", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay is restored, the Legacy recovered, and the Weatherlight sails for Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria.

citation.text: Tranquility (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy Weapon.
timeline.quote: asked Gerrard to take out his powerstone eyes and place them in two sockets in Karn's chest

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard places Urza's powerstone eyes into Karn; the Legacy destroys the Phyrexians and Yawgmoth, and Karn becomes the first artificial planeswalker.
timeline.quote: the powerstones turned Karn into the first artificial planeswalker

citation.text: "Karn", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legacy is completed by the sacrifice of Urza, Gerrard and Karn, destroying Yawgmoth's essence and ending the invasion.
timeline.quote: the Legacy was completed through the sacrifice of Urza , Gerrard Capashen , and Karn

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn uses the Thran Tome to integrate the Legacy into Weatherlight, rebuilding it and granting it sentience.
timeline.quote: finally, granting the ship sentience

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy; light eradicates Yawgmoth's essence.
timeline.quote: Light spreads all over the world, eradicating Yawgmoth's essence.

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight launches the Legacy Weapon, Yawgmoth seizes the ship, and Karn, Urza and Gerrard merge into a radiant light that defeats Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: the light defeated Yawgmoth

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven's moggs loot the Legacy artifacts, including Karn.
timeline.quote: ordered his moggs to loot the artifacts of the Legacy

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn encounters the Sliver Queen and claims the Legacy pieces.
timeline.quote: Karn encountered the Sliver Queen in her lair

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes and that its pieces were stolen from the child Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I know it to be the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard places Urza's Powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy Weapon.
timeline.quote: Gerrard removed Urza’s Powerstone eyes

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah realizes the place is Urza's failsafe, the Legacy, and plans to tell Teferi; Mishra relays Urza's final words about ending conflicts.
timeline.quote: This whole place—it's Urza's failsafe in case he perished before he could deploy it against the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight and its crew, with the Legacy including Karn, thwart Phyrexia's near invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia nearly invaded Dominaria, were it not for the skyship Weatherlight and its crew.

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Karn seeks the Legacy pieces to be whole.
relations.quote: I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole

citation.text: Victual Sliver (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Karn becomes an accumulation of the whole Legacy
relations.quote: The golem reveals he is an accumulation of the entire Legacy

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Assembled the Legacy to defeat Yawgmoth.
relations.quote: The Legacy was a collection of artifacts assembled by Urza

citation.text: "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
